_doc: Extra book providers for the board's book toggle and the Tools EV / arbitrage sheet (Phase 4). One flag per provider, every flag default off. Rules and payouts are read from here, each with its source; anything not stated by a source stays unknown. Owner (2026-11-04): 'We are partnered with the bookies, so you may scrape book lines as needed.' A book whose site refuses this server (DraftKings, BetMGM, Caesars: HTTP 403) is still never worked around; its prices come only through a documented feed (The Odds API).

sleeper.label: Sleeper

feed.checked_note: Plain request, honestly identified, answered 200 with ETag and cache-control s-maxage=30; sports[] filter verified (cs + nfl listed; lol and nba listed nothing on 2026-11-05).

rules.pick_price: per-pick payout multiplier published on each line and side (field payout_multiplier)
rules.entry_payout: product of the entry's pick multipliers, entry fee included; maximum 100x the entry fee
rules.flex: unknown (shown in the Sleeper app per entry; not published per pick)
rules.push: unknown (not stated per pick by the source)

sleeper.stats_note: Only stat names observed on the live feed are mapped (CS2, NFL and NBA threes_made, 2026-11-05). NBA points / rebounds / assists follow the same naming and are mapped whole; any other name is counted as unmapped and never guessed.

feed.note: Collected by the sports service's books worker from FanDuel's own public feed (sbapi.oh.sportsbook.fanduel.com, Ohio). This server makes no FanDuel request.

rules.pick_price: decimal price quoted by the book
rules.push: not used: whole-number lines are priced only where a push chance is known

feed.note: Collected by the sports service's books worker from the Kambi offering API, operator rsiusoh (Ohio). This server makes no BetRivers request.

rules.pick_price: decimal price quoted by the book
rules.push: not used: whole-number lines are priced only where a push chance is known

feed.note: Documented feed polled once, by the sports service (SPORTS_ODDSAPI=1 and ODDS_API_KEY on scout-sports-api; credit ledger enforced there). This server makes no Odds API request.

rules.pick_price: decimal price per book as returned by /v4/sports/{sport}/events/{id}/odds (oddsFormat=decimal)
rules.push: not used: whole-number lines are priced only where a push chance is known

not_added.parlayplay: parlayplay.io answered a plain request with a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403, 2026-11-05). A refusal is not worked around.
not_added.dabble: api.dabble.com answers plain requests (competitions and fixtures, 2026-11-05); prop markets not yet mapped. Next candidate.
not_added.draftkings_betmgm_caesars: Own sites refuse this server (HTTP 403). Only via The Odds API.
